changelog:
- Initial release with support for organizing and maintaining Obsidian-style Markdown vaults.
- Provides workflows for note cleanup, frontmatter management, link repair, template creation, and migration planning.
- Emphasizes safe, reversible changes with explicit audit and validation steps.
- Works entirely with local files; avoids cloud-dependent assumptions.
- Designed to preserve note privacy and existing user formatting unless instructed otherwise.
